sections.text_helper: Section 26.7.3 "RNG data register (RNG_DR)" in chapter 26 (True random number generator (RNG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 788.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x008
Reset value: 0x00000000
This register is a read-only register that delivers a 32-bit random value when read. The
content of this register is valid when the DRDY=1 and the value is not 0x0, even if
RNGEN=0.
Bits 31:0 RNDATA[31:0]: Random data
32-bit random data, valid when DRDY=1. When DRDY=0, the RNDATA value is0.
The 0 value means that a seed error occurred between RNG_SR polling and RND_DR
output reading (a rare event).
